seo.title: ODD — a co-creation platform for creativity and business
seo.description: A co-creation platform on a mission to bring creativity and business together to shape a more imaginative world. ODDfest, ODDference, ODDspace, ODDagency — Helsinki.

hero.mosaicAlt: A live photo mosaic from the ODDfest archive

openingLine: A co-creation platform on a mission to bring creativity and business together to shape a more imaginative world.

converge.intro: There are two ways in — pick where you start.

business.body: We work with businesses two ways. ODDference puts your team in the room with the people actually building Finland's creative economy — talks, matchmaking, a stage if you want one. ODDagency goes further: commission real creative production, not just a conversation about it.

creative.body: We support creatives two ways. ODDfest is the open program — free to join, shaped by whoever shows up to build it, no gatekeeping. ODDspace is where that continues year-round: a studio, a membership, a home base in Helsinki.

news.caption: Three days, five venues, one wild weekend.
Where business met the creative sector.
